This is extraordinarily touching story, however, it is extremely painful that you know it's true and it's still ongoing to other children.

It is unbelievable how the movie gets you inside the story by a way you could not imagine it is possible.

This movie deserves every word it got. All respect to all the cast.

Kaouther Ben Hania's The Voice of Hind Rajab is devastating because it refuses to look away. Reconstructing the real emergency calls from a 6-year-old trapped under Israeli fire in Gaza, the film captures the terror of a child pleading for rescue while adults fail her. It's not "politics," it's accountability: collective punishment, siege tactics that starve civilians, and strikes that kill women and children are clear violations of international humanitarian law. The movie never sensationalizes; it lets Hind's voice, and the chilling silence that follows, speak for itself. This is essential cinema-an act of remembrance and a demand for justice. If you believe films can confront crimes and save lives by forcing truth into the light, watch this and add your voice to Hind's.

Cried so much. I hope this movie make people open their eyes of the truth about what is happening and the consequences of not taking action now. At this point of time, you are either on the right or wrong side of history. No human or more specifically child deserves to go through all this under whatsoever conditions. War is not justification of killing children.

THE VOICE OF HIND RAJAB (2025) Tunisian Kaouther Ben Hania's intense docu-drama about a brave 5 year old Palestinian girl in Gaza trapped in car with the bullet ridden bodies of her family around her. Hind Rajib's story made world news in 2024.

What distinguishes Ben Hania's moving portrait is her use of actual emergency call recordings of the nearly three hours that Hind Rajib remained in phone contact with the Red Crescent call center employees and her mother and uncle. The actors portraying the volunteers bring genuine urgency and emotion to their portrayals. The body of the movie takes place entirely within the emergency response headquarters. There is also documentary footage utilized.

Ben Hania remains rigidly non-political in her approach. The anger is directed at the agencies on both sides who are paralyzed by the 'rules' of engagement even with the life of a lonely panicked five year old at stake. It's a humanitarian approach which reaches beyond the headlines and social media. Ben Hania's previous equally fine drama THE MAN WHO SOLD HIS SKIN and her documentary FOUR DAUGHTERS were each Oscar nominated (VOICE OF HIND RAJAB has recently been nominated for a Golden Globe and made the Oscar shortlist for International Film).

THE VOICE OF HIND RAJAB brings a palpable sense of the toll of the Middle East conflict around one young girl. Ben Hania made compassionate choice not to use an actreess to portray Hind Rajab. Her innocent voice is a quiet and haunting clarion call.

This might be the most anticipated movie of 2025. Kaouther Ben Hania has shown great potential for conveying emotion through her work and giving voice to the voiceless. Art should be used for such humane causes, defending the most basic human rights. On the same events, Macklemore released two songs last year.
